{{Quote
| If your idle claws need work, put them to service for our exalted Great Gourmand. I must remain by my master, so you will need to leave the Citadel and gather the ingredients for their meal in my stead!
| [[Loyal Mergwin]]
| Hr = SS
}}

<b>Great Taste of Pharloom</b> is a [[Gather Wishes|Gather Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be acquired by talking to [[Loyal Mergwin]] within the [[Choral Chambers]].

== Wish ==
Loyal Mergwin asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to collect 5 rare delicacies across [[Pharloom]] for the [[Great Gourmand]] to feast on, which are the <b>Mossberry Stew</b>, <b>Vintage Nectar</b>, <b>Courier's Rasher</b>, <b>Crustnut</b> and the <b>Pickled Muckmaggot</b>. Speaking to Loyal Mergwin without any items to give him will prompt him to provide a hint for the location of one of the items she has not yet collected.
<br><br>

=== [[Mossberry Stew]] ===
[[File:Mossberry Stew.png|link=Mossberry Stew|left|thumb|75x75px]]

The Mossberry Stew is freely given by the [[Moss Druid]] in [[Mosshome]] during the wish.
{{Clear}}

=== [[Vintage Nectar]] ===
[[File:Vintage Nectar.png|link=Vintage Nectar|left|thumb|75x75px]]

The Vintage Nectar can be bought from [[Creige]] in [[Greymoor#Sub-area: Halfway Home|Halfway Home]] for {{R|480}}. After payment, Creige allows Hornet to enter his basement where, after defending against a Skarr ambush, she can acquire the nectar. This step cannot be completed while Hornet is [[Cursed Crest|cursed]] as [[Creige]] will not offer to sell the Vintage Nectar to Hornet.

{{Clear}}

=== [[Courier's Rasher]] ===
[[File:Courier's Rasher.png|link=Courier's Rasher|left|thumb|75x75px]]

The Courier's Rasher is given as a delivery item by [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]] in [[Bellhart]] after having completed the <i>[[My Missing Brother]]</i> wish, and operates under the same rules as a [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]]. It has a total of 8 hit points that slowly drain at a rate of 1 hit point every 47 seconds. As long as the hit point has not fully drained, it is still considered a full hit point when the item takes damage.

{{Clear}}

=== [[Crustnut]] ===
[[File:Crustnut.png|link=Crustnut|left|thumb|80x80px]]

The [[Crustnut]] can be found hidden within the [[Sands of Karak]], behind various breakable walls and floors.

{{Clear}}

=== [[Pickled Muckmaggot]] ===
[[File:Pickled Muckmaggot.png|link=Pickled Muckmaggot|left|thumb|75x75px]]

The Pickled Muckmaggot can be obtained after defeating [[Disgraced Chef Lugoli]] in [[Sinner's Road]]. The [[Faydown Cloak]] is required to enter their arena.

{{Clear}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Pale Oil.png|link=Pale Oil|left|thumb|100x100px]]
After bringing all 5 items to Loyal Mergwin and having the Great Gourmand feast, Loyal Mergwin allows Hornet to take the [[Pale Oil]] behind him.

{{clear}}
